plans.idea: Classic top-down poster: brand mark, then a generous text block (headline plus the flavour list), then the product lineup with the hero bag and its two siblings together, and the Build Your Pack pill closing at the bottom as the action.

Product-first: the big hero bag with the two sibling bags beside it forms the upper half's focal point under a small brand mark, then the copy reads below and finishes on a centred CTA pill, so the order is brand to product to message to action.

Headline-led with a brand sign-off: the text block opens the canvas at full width, the bag lineup sits mid-canvas as one group, and the CTA pill and Solstice logo stack centred at the foot like an end card.
